visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Last Reversal Starts Too Late
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Rotating 1 to 7 right by 3 should give [5, 6, 7, 1, 2, 3, 4], but the program prints [5, 6, 7, 4, 1, 2, 3].

solution.explanation: After reversing the first k elements, the remaining part starts exactly at index k. Starting at k + 1 leaves the element at index k out of the reversal, so it stays in the wrong place.
